_comment: The discovery universe: events comparable to Nocturnal Valley, ranked by how much a sponsorship there says about fit here. The ICP is the deck's own (slide 4): 24-34 primary / 18-23 secondary, Midwest, experience seekers, electronic music and camping. A company on one of these sponsor lists arrives with dated activation evidence by construction — which is the entire advantage over brainstorming categories. Verification states are honest: 'verified' means read in a session with the date noted; everything else is checked during discovery, never assumed.

icp.market: St. Louis (venue: Astral Valley Art Park, French Village, MO)
icp.window: sponsorships dated 2026, strongest in Q2-Q3 (the season a September festival's budgets move in)

tiers.1_same_format_and_region: Midwest + electronic + camping. A sponsor here has already bought exactly what Nocturnal Valley sells.
tiers.2_same_market: St. Louis events of any format. The sponsor already spends in this market; Evolution's pause frees those budgets for 2026.
tiers.3_national_edm: National electronic properties. Proves category appetite and an experiential budget; regional fit still needs its own evidence.
tiers.4_same_venue: Prior events at Astral Valley Art Park itself. The strongest possible comp when it exists.

events.note: The pause is the opportunity: every 2025 Evolution sponsor has a proven St. Louis festival budget with no 2026 home. This list outranks its tier for that reason.

Not electronic-first, but the definitive Q2 2026 record of which drinks brands buy festival activations.
